name: Gathered Whispers

source.note: Entered from published reviews and guides to Ravenloft: The Horrors Within (and Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft, which it revises); compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Ravenloft Dark Gift. Message, a free Augury and a Reaction that adds your Proficiency Bonus to AC; a natural 1 can drown you in whispers.

benefits.name: Whispering Magic
benefits.summary: You know Message; Augury is always prepared and free once per Long Rest.
benefits.text: You know the Message cantrip, and you always have Augury prepared; you can cast Augury once without a spell slot, regaining that use on a Long Rest. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you take the gift).

benefits.name: Whispered Warning
benefits.summary: Reaction when an attack would hit you: add your Proficiency Bonus to your AC against it (PB times per Long Rest).
benefits.text: When you are hit by an attack roll, the whispers warn you: you can take a Reaction to add your Proficiency Bonus to your AC against that attack, possibly turning the hit into a miss. You can do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses on a Long Rest.

drawback.name: Drawback
drawback.summary: On a natural 1: Wisdom save (DC 13 + PB) or Deafened, with Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls, until the end of your next turn.
drawback.text: Whenever you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus); on a failure the whispers roar: you have the Deafened condition and Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls until the end of your next turn.
